ValidationRule.description: Prevent changes to Contact.Portal_Alias__c after the unique key has been established.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Permission.Bypass_Restrict_Portal_Alias ) , ISCHANGED( Portal_Alias__c ) , NOT( ISBLANK( PRIORVALUE( Portal_Alias__c ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Not allowed to change Portal Alias.
